title: The Thankful Leper
reflectionQuestion: The thankful man ran all the way back just to say thank you. What is something you feel thankful for right now?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles, secondary/short-only). The GRATITUDE thread, centered on JOY not guilt (Adam): the nine are mentioned gently ('so excited to get home they did not look back') with NO scolding/guilt-lesson; the heart is the one man's joyful thankfulness. Leprosy softened to 'a sickness that made them sore and sad, had to live apart' -- no graphic detail; flag illness_softened. Indelible image = the one man running all the way back, kneeling at Jesus' feet, 'Thank you! Oh, thank you!'. Distinct healing from 1806 Jairus + 1848 Bartimaeus (this one is about giving thanks). 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL (pastoral) -- fits returning to praise/give thanks.
